title: Research report
description: Data for templates/research-report.html: the research supervisor's status update when a research commission ends or pauses. It shows what the commission accomplished (workstream states, measured results), overall progress per scorecard dimension (judged by the supervisor, with a level and a reason each), the operator's earlier feedback and what changed because of it, and what comes next. Sent with --kind status. The operator can set a weight per workstream (answer key 'weight.<workstream id>' = weight key, removed when set back to the workstream's current weight) and add a note in the Hub's answer bar. Every section carries a source; a section without real data is left out or sent with source.status 'unavailable', and the page says so instead of drawing it. Never fill a section with estimates that are not labelled as estimates.

template.description: Optional self-identification; when present must be 'research-report'.

title.description: Headline: the commission's outcome in one sentence, e.g. 'GPU image work is live. Most of the rest waited on shared files and on you.'

lede.description: Two or three sentences: why the commission ended, what landed, what the next one starts with.

topic.description: Research topic name, e.g. 'Local model performance'.

timezone.description: IANA time zone for every date on the page. Default: the device's zone.

notice.description: Optional note under the header, e.g. that the data is a sample.

id.description: Commission or packet ID (shown in technical details).

ended.description: Why it ended: completed its plan, paused by the supervisor, usage allowance ran out, time window ended, stopped by the operator.

agentHours.description: Measured agent hours spent in the commission.

states.description: Workstream state vocabulary, in display order. Default: landed (good), running (accent), parked (warn), waiting_on_you (crit), stopped (muted).

summary.description: This commission at a glance: headline tiles; the state bar is drawn from workstreams.

title.description: Section heading; a default is used when absent.

tiles.description: Up to four headline numbers, e.g. 1 landed, 4 new measurements.

measurements.description: Measured results: each a before/after (or A/B) bar pair whose colour shows good, warning or bad.

title.description: Section heading; a default is used when absent.

items.description: Measurements taken in this commission, most important first.

title.description: What was measured, e.g. 'Whisper idle GPU memory'.

unit.description: Unit shown after each value, e.g. 'MiB', 's'. Use 'x' for a ratio (shown as 23.5x).

values.description: The compared values, the reference first (earlier, before, CPU) and the result last.

better.description: Which direction is better; the page states the change as e.g. '622x less'. Default lower.

verdict.description: The supervisor's verdict; colours the result bars green, amber or red.

note.description: One sentence on what it means.

evidence.description: Where the number comes from (file, run id); shown on tap.

scorecard.description: Overall progress toward the topic's target, per scorecard dimension. The supervisor judges each level and records its reason. Include both was and now only when numeric progress is available; omit both when it is not.

title.description: Section heading; a default is used when absent.

scale.description: Common scale for numeric was/now/target values. Omit when numeric progress is unavailable. Default 0-100 percent of target.

judgedBy.description: Who judged the levels, e.g. 'Research supervisor review'.

levels.description: The ordered level names the supervisor uses, lowest first, e.g. Not started, Early, Partial, Working, Done. Shown as a ladder.

dimensions.description: One row per scorecard dimension, in the topic's order.

was.description: Numeric progress on the scale when the commission started. Include together with now only when both values are recorded; omit both when unavailable.

now.description: Numeric progress now. Include together with was only when both values are recorded; omit both when unavailable.

target.description: Numeric target on the scale; only use with a recorded was/now pair. Default scale.max.

level.description: The supervisor's judged level, e.g. 'Partial' (one of levels when given).

reason.description: Why that level: the evidence the supervisor judged from.

today.description: What is true today in plain words; revealed on tap.

workstreams.description: Every workstream with its state, what it waits for, and a weight the operator can set for the next commission.

title.description: Section heading; a default is used when absent.

weights.description: Weight choices. Default hold, normal, more.

effect.description: What this weight does next commission, e.g. 'Gets an owner first'.

id.description: Short id, e.g. 'LM17'; used in the answer key.

note.description: What happened and what it waits for, one or two sentences.

weight.description: Current recorded weight key. Omit when the current weight is unknown; the page then leaves all alternatives unselected and reports that no weight was recorded.

steerable.description: Whether a weight can be set. Default true; false for finished workstreams.

feedback.description: The operator's earlier feedback and what the supervisor changed because of it (read back at commission start).

title.description: Section heading; a default is used when absent.

said.description: What the operator said, quoted or closely paraphrased.

when.description: When or where, e.g. '16 Nov, 05:54' or 'Review, 12 and 14 Nov'.

status.description: Whether the change is in effect. Default applied.

why.description: When partly or not yet: why.

next.description: What comes next: the following lines with agent-hour estimate ranges.

title.description: Section heading; a default is used when absent.

note.description: One line under the bars, e.g. why this order.

why.description: One line: why it is next or what it unlocks.

dimension.description: Scorecard dimension key it moves; shown with its name.

source.description: Data provenance for one section, shown as a badge. 'unavailable' replaces the section's chart with a plain notice.

status.description: real: measured; partial: some parts measured, the rest missing (say which in note); unavailable: the source is missing.

label.description: Where the data comes from, e.g. 'Agent Manager forecast'.

note.description: What is missing or how it was measured; shown on tap and in the unavailable notice.

pill.description: A short status label on a card.

tone.description: Colour: good green, warn amber, crit red, info accent.

technical.description: IDs, rules and evidence for the agent that acts, in a collapsed section.

tone.description: Colour: a series number 1-8 (1 blue, 2 orange, 3 amber, 4 pink, 5 violet, 6 green, 7 slate, 8 teal) or a named tone.

value.description: The number (or a short value such as '3d 15h').

unit.description: Small text after the value, e.g. '%' or ' of 14'.

tone.description: Side bar colour; omit for neutral.
